tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gu ru pad+ma thod phreng gi sbyin sreg sgrib sel nyi 'od bzhugs pa'i dbu'o// na mo gu ru pad+mā kā rā ya/ bla ma pad+ma thod phreng la/ /gus btud de yi sbyin sreg bshad/ /'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ /dang po sbyor bar don drug las/ /dang po thab ni nyams dga'i sar/ / sgrub gnas rnying pa'am sa chog byas pa'i sar/ thig chen brgyad btab de dbus nas/ /khru phyed zlum bskor thab dngos dang / /de phyir sor bzhi zlum bskor gnyis/ /kha khyer dang ni mu ran te/ /de gnyis gang rung rdo rjes bskor/ /de phyir sor bzhi gru bzhi gnyis/ /stegs bu dang ni de dpangs tshad/ /stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed la/ /rdo rje'i rtse mo nang bstan 'dri/ /thab dbus sum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i/ /sum cha zlum por bskor nang du/ /'khor lo'i lte bar sum cha gcig /rtsibs bzhi'i sa la sum gnyis bya/ /dbus su gru gsum rtse mdun bstan/ /thab gzhi thams cad dkar po la/ /bcad rnams dmar skya'am dkar pos bya/ /'khor lo chos 'byung bcas pa sngo/ /gnyis ka'i mu khyud ljang gus bya/ /dbus su pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /rdo rje rtse mo dmar po dang / /shar du byang chub mchod rten nang / /pad nyi'i steng du rdo rje sngo/ /lho phyogs 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi ser/ /lte bar pad zla ral gri dang / /nub tu pad dmar 'dab bzhi'i steng / /pad+mas mtshan pa'i dbyug tho dang / /byang du rdo rje sngon po'i lter/ /pad nyir tho ba 'dri ba'am/ /yang na dbus su tshon spung dmar/ /shar sngo lho ser nub dmar dang / /byang du sngon po'am yang na ni/ /nas dang 'bras sogs gang rung gi /'khor lo'i dbus dang phyogs bzhi dang / /thab kyi shar lhor tshom bu bkod/ /gnyis pa zhi ba'i bud shing gi /kha khyer steng nas zlum brtsigs nang / /shar lho'i mtshams su ting lo bzhag /gsum pa rdo lcags drag shing sogs/ /gtsubs las ma yin rgyun bzhag gam/

/zhi zhing rtsub pa'i me las bya/ /bzhi pa sreg rdzas mchod rdzas dang / /sman raka gtor bsngo bskang ba sogs kyi gtor ma gang dgos bshams/ gtor ma ku sha brgyad/ /'og tu gang dgos sta gon bya/ /lnga pa thab kyi mtha' bskor rnams/ /byi dor byas la dri bzang byugs/ /thab mdun rang stan nang tshang can/ /rang g.yon thab kyi g.yas ngos nas/ /sman raka gtor gsum chu gnyis dang / /nyer spyod lnga bshams rang gi g.yas/ /thab kyi g.yon nas rim pa bzhin/ /yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / /so ba 'bras nas gro dang ni/ /sran ma dur ba ku sha rnams/ /legs bshams rang mdun stegs kyi khar/ /dri dung 'thor yab rdor dril dang / /de bar dgang blugs ḍā ma ru/ /nang mchod 'thor nas legs bshams la/ /rdzas kun nang mchod bsang gtor bya/ /thab dang sgrub pa po yi bar/ /me yol gangs ri chu waṃ 'dri/ /drug pa nyi ma'i dgong gi char/ /rang nyid khrus byas gos rgyan dkar/ /sdig sogs zhi sems kha shar blta/ /skyil krung pus 'khyud tsog pu'o/ /dngos gzhi la yang don drug las/ /dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ /'phrin gzhung dregs pa zil gnon ltar/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te/ /bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar bya'o/ spro na brgyud 'debs kyang bya/ /gnyis pa me btsal sgrub pa ni/ /spor lde sbar la thal mos bzung / /rtsa sngags bzla zhing thab khung la/ /g.yas bskor lan gsum byas pa'i mthar/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod thab nang ting lo sbar/ /phur pa'i sbyin sreg las 'og tu sbar bar gsungs kyang 'dir sbar bar stabs bde/ rtswa shing bzang pos me kha gsos/ /dgang blugs mar dang bcas pa ni/ /dz+wa la'i sngags brjod lan gsum phul/ /gsum pa thab yo bsang ba ni/ /bsangs chur rdo rjes nang mchod gtor/ /badz+ra yak+ṣas bsangs bya zhing / /swa bhā'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las shaṃ yig las/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i dung phor nang /

/hūm̐ las bsang bar byed pa'i chu/ /thab dang yo byad thams cad kyi/ /ma dag sel ba'i nus ldan gyur/ /badz+ra yak+ṣa ci mang brjod/ /sngags de brjod cing 'thor yab kyi/ /mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas bsang gtor bya/ /swa bhā'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las bhan+dha cher/ /sman raka gtor sogs mchod rdzas dang / /bsregs rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med/ /kun bzang rnam thar bzhin gyur nas/ /zhi ba'i las kun 'grub par gyur/ /sman raka gtor gsum sngags rgya rnams/ /lan gsum bya ba nas brtsams te/ /gu h+ya ma hā pu tsa hoḥ 'di bar 'phrin gzhung bzhin du bya/ /mchod yon phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hās yams shing dang / /oṃ shrī swāhās mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swāhās 'bru/ oṃ oṃ swāhās rdzas rnams bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhās rdzas rnams sbyangs/ /bzhi pa thab mngon 'du bya ba ni/ /gong bzhin bsangs chu sngags bcas dang / /swa bhās thab la bsangs sbyangs bya/ /paṃ pad raṃ nyi'i gdan steng du/ /hūm̐ las zhi thab zlum zhing dkar/ /rgya dang zab kyi tshad dag tu/ /khru gang khru byed kha khyer dang / /mu ran la ni rdo rjes mtshan/ /phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi'i grwar/ /zla phyed rdo rjes legs spras shing / /dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ /lnga pa 'jig rten me mchod ni/ /de dbus pad+ma nyi ma'i steng / /raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan/ /'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs gyur las/ /ra skyes steng du me lha'i sku/ /dmar po 'od dkar 'phro zhing 'du/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis bgrang phreng dang / /spyi blugs 'dzin zhing gsus khyim che/ /thor tshugs sma ra ag tshom 'phyang / /drang srong tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ /dpral mgrin snying khar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis/ /shar lho'i mtshams nas drang srong che/ /me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur/ /lag gnyis mthe bong gung rtsa dang / /mdzub mo gung rgyab bkab byas nas/

/rna ba g.yas g.yon drung nas g.yab/ /oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsregs blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ag+ne ye ma hā te dza sarba karma pra sa dha ka ma hā bhu ta/ de wi dza ya satwaṃ/ ma gṛ hi twa/ sarba sat+tār+tha kri twa āḥhūm̐ ti asmin san+ti hi twa bha wa pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ i daṃ zhes pa nas/ gu h+ya ma hā pu dza hoḥ 'di bar 'phrin gzhung bzhin brjod mthar/ /rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo bsgrengs/ /de rgyab mdzub mo gnyis kyis mnan/ /mtheb chen mtheb chung so sor sbyar/ /bsgreng ba rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang / /oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la ya sarba duṣ+ṭan bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ tri sh+ya hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod me lha dam la bzhag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabyer med gyur/ /rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis/ /dbang lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'di la dbang bskur stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag /chu zhabs spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ /rnam snang chen pos rgyas btab gyur/ /ku sha brgyad po bsangs chu dang / /yak+ṣa swa bhās bsangs sbyang bya/ /hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo/ /rtsa rtse ma nyams thab yo yi/ /ma dag sel ba'i nus ldan gyur/ /thal mo'i bar bzung 'di skad brjod/ /oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /bgegs dang mi mthun phyogs zhi zhing / /las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ

zhes brjod phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi ru/ /g.yas skor dag tu bkram par bya/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya yis/ /dgang gzar blug gzar bzung nas su/ /drang srong chen po me lha'i ljags/ /hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga dang / /dgang blugs kha la raṃ gyis mtshan/ /oṃ ag+na ye oṃ ag+na dī bya bi shud+dhe ma hā shrī ye bya ka bya ba hā na ya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag dang / /sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa/ /nyes kun shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ /de 'dra lan gsum byon zan phul/ /mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /i daṃ nas bzung ma hā pu dza: ho zhes gsang ba'i mchod pa'i bar/ /phrin gzhung bzhin brjod ḍā dril gsil/ /rdor dril 'dzin pas 'di skad brjod/ /'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gi nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /skabs 'dir me pra brtag pa ni/ /saṃ bu ṭar gsungs go rim che'i/ /tshigs bcad mdzad las 'di skad du/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rdo rje dang / /zhes pa nas bzung khro bo yis/ /bgegs rnams zhi bar bya zhes par/ /de nang bzhin du brtags pa'am/ /mdor bsdus kha dog dkar po la/ /snum zhing snyan pa'i sgra skad dang / /du ba chung ba zhi las shis/ /du ba che zhing me stag 'phro/ /zhi la ngan pas bsangs chu gtor/ /hūm̐ zhes bgegs rnams bskrad par bya/ /de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /yam shing byang chub shing mos la/ /oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swāhā/ /de skad lan bdun phul ba'i mthar/ /oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swāhā/ bdag dang sems can thams cad sogs/ /spel tshig gong bzhin brjod par bya/ /de bzhin 'og ma kun la sbyar/ /oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes pas mar dang til la ni/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swāhā/ /zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog la/

/oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ so ba'i 'bras la/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swāhā/ dkar mo'i 'bras la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swāhā/ nas la/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swāhā/ gro la/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swāhā/ sran ma la/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swāhā/ dur wa la/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swāhā/ ku sha la/ oṃ a pra ti badz+rā ya swāhā/ de ltar rdzas rnams phul ba'i mthar/ /bsang chu me nang cung zad blugs/ /oṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ añca ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas bsang gtor zhabs bsil phul/ /dgang blugs mar gang 'bul ba dang / /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ /'jig rten me lha mchod pa'o/ /drug pa 'das pa'i me lha ni/ /bud shing bsreg rdzas mchod rdzas rnams/ /cung zad kha gsos bsangs chu dang / /yak+ṣa'i sngags dang swa bhā was/ /bsangs sbyang byas la bskyed pa ni/ /chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje yi/ /zhes pa nas bzung brtan bzhugs bar/ /'phrin gzhung las 'byung ji bzhin la/ /tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim pa las/ /de nyid zil gnon pad+ma'i sku/ /zhes dang gzhan yang mi 'dra ba/ /de yi spyi bor yi ge oṃ/ /ser po 'od dang ldan par gyur/ /zhes dang gsung thugs gnyis la yang / /dmar po 'od dang ldan par gyur/ /mthing nag 'od dang ldan par gyur/ /zhes dang yak+ṣa me dbal la/ /de nas de yi thugs ka nas/ /zhes sogs bdag mdun khyad par sbyar/ /rtsa sngags lan gsum gyis bsngags pa'i/ /mar sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa/ /bdun gsum byon zan 'bul tshul ni/ /gong bkod 'jig rten me lha bzhin/ /de nas mchod pa nas brtsams te/ /bstod pa rdzogs bar phrin gzhung bzhin/ /bsreg rdzas 'bul rim gong bzhin la/ /rtsa sngags kho nas 'bul ba'am/ /sngon du rtsa sngags lan gsum bzlas/ /rdzas sngags rnams kyis phul kyang chog /rtsa sngags rdzas sngags gang yin kyang / /mjug tu gong gi spel tshig sbyar/ /de nas bcu cha'i sbyin sreg ni/ /til dang phreng bar grangs bzung la/ pang du snod bzhag la bsags/

/bzlas pa 'bum phrag bzhi la ni/ /khri phrag bzhi yi sbyin sreg ste/ /sbyin bsregs tshugs nyin chig khri dang / /bar nyin nyi khri grol chog la/ /chig khri bzla bas cho ga bzhi/ /stong re'i mtshams su 'bul tshan re/ /yongs rdzogs grub nas byon zan ltar/ /gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun phul/ /gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ /lan gcig sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gsang mchod sogs/ /'jig rten pa yi me lha bzhin/ /rang byung pad+ma thod phreng sogs/ /bstod pa byas gtor bsngo bskang ba sogs byed kyang 'dir bya la tshogs nas brtsams/ /bstan ma skyong bar 'phrin gzhung bzhin/ /'on kyang tha ma bsgral mchod ni/ /sbyin sreg grol nyin byas kyang chog /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs/ /zhes sogs dngos grub blang ba nas/ /gshegs bsdu'i dkyil 'khor bsdu ba 'di sa skya na 'don cha la mi mdzad kyang brjod na legs par sems bar rnams 'phrin gzhung bzhin/ /lag g.yon mtheb srin thab thal blangs/ /dpral bar reg pa dngos gzhi'o/ /rjes chog la'ang don drug las/ /'jig rten me lha lhag mchod ni/ /dgang blugs mar bkang thab nang blug /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ me lha zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /dwangs shing thogs med sku can gyur/ /bsregs rdzas 'bul tshul gong bkod bzhin/ /gang ba'i sbyin sreg byon zan bzhin/ /mchod bstod rnams kyang gong bzhin bya/ /gnyis pa gtor ma btang ba ni/ /zlum gtor nang mchod chu chang sbyangs/ /yak+ṣa'i sngags dang swa bhā was/ /bsangs sbyangs byas la stong par bsgom/ /stong pa'i ngang las rin chen snod/ /yangs shing rgya cher gtor ma mchog /kha dog dri ro nus ldan pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ /zhes dang 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / /drang srong me lha'i mtshan sngags la/ /a kā ro btags gtor ma phul/ /mchod bstod thams cad gong bzhin la/ /bstod pa ring ba 'di yang brjod/

/tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyabs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis skur ston pa/ /rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghun+dhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la sim/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gsum pa 'dod don zhu ba ni/ /drang srong chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /zhes pa nas bzung yongs rdzogs bya/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ /bzhi pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ /oṃ prok+ṣa naṃ añca ma naṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas bsang gtor zhabs bsil phul/ bsangs chu nas thab nang du gtor/ /spyan 'dren phyag rgya phyir bskyed la/ /bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis sgrub kyin gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ ag+na ye ya hi gats+tsha/ /me lha rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ /dam tshig sems dpa' rang la thim/ /lnga pa lhag chad kha bskang ni/ /yi ge brgya pa kha yar bzla/ rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka gang rung / phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs/ /bsngo smon shis brjod 'phrin gzhung bzhin/ tshogs la longs spyad nub rjes mar lhag gtor btang / /drug pa las rjes bsdu ba ni/ /de lta bu yi sbyin sreg skabs/ /me dkyil mi dkrugs phus mi gdabs/ /ma shi bar du bsgul mi bya/ /bud shing yam shing la sogs pa/ /rdzas yod kun la 'bags btsog gi

/dri nog nam yang mi bya ste/ /me lha drang srong yin phyir ro/ /de ltar pad+ma thod phreng gi /sbyin sreg sgrib sel nyi 'od 'di/ /slob bu bkra shis rin chen gyis/ /bskul ngor 'khon rigs sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis/ /thams cad mkhyen pa a mes zhabs/ /gang des mdzad pa'i phur pa yi/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg phrin las ni/ /lhun gyis grub pa gzhir bzhag nas/ /gu ru drag po'i khyad chos rnams/ /rgya gar sher bzang gis mdzad pa'i/ /'phrin gzhung dregs pa zil gnon dang / /snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i/ /dbang chog mthong ba rang grol dang / /las mtha' gsal byed yi ge bzhin/ /bkod pas 'di la rang bzo med/ /'on kyang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /nyes pa mchis na 'gro kun gyis/ /bsags pa'i sdig dang lhan cig tu/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags/ /dge des sems can thams cad kyi/ kun bzang go 'phang thob gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gu ru pad+ma thod phreng gi sbyin sreg sgrib sel nyi 'od/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
